[attribute-ref-type]
=== `@ref-type` Type of Cross-Reference

Type of element that is the target of the cross-reference (for example, a figure (“`fig`”), a table (“`table`”), or a footnote (“`fn`”). The values may be used for type-specific processing or validation.

#### Usage/Remarks
The <<element-xref,`<xref>`>> element may be used to reference any element in the standard document that has an <<attribute-id,`@id`>> attribute. This single element takes the place of the many named types of references (such as figure references, table references, and footnote references) that are common in many tag sets. This attribute states the element to which the cross-reference is pointing.

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-xref,`<xref>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| abbreviation| Abbreviation or acronym.
| aff| Affiliation.
| app| Appendix.
| author-notes| Author notes.
| award| Points to the description of or identifier for a grant or 
                        award (<<element-award-id,`<award-id>`>>).
| bibr| Bibliographic reference (typically to a <<element-ref,`<ref>`>> element, but it may point to a <<element-element-citation,`<element-citation>`>> or an <<element-mixed-citation,`<mixed-citation>`>> if there are multiple citations
                        inside the <<element-ref,`<ref>`>> element).
| bio| Biography
| boxed-text| Textbox or sidebar.
| chem| Chemical structure (to a <<element-chem-struct,`<chem-struct>`>> or <<element-chem-struct-wrap,`<chem-struct-wrap>`>> element).
| contrib| Contributor.
| collab| Collaboration.
| corresp| Corresponding author.
| custom| Not one of the meanings named in this list. The type can be found as the value of
                        the attribute <<attribute-custom-type,`@custom-type`>>.
| disp-formula| Display formula.
| fig| Figure or group of figures (to a <<element-fig,`<fig>`>> or <<element-fig-group,`<fig-group>`>>
                        element).
| fn| Footnote.
| kwd| Keyword.
| list| List or list item (to a <<element-list,`<list>`>>
                        or <<element-list-item,`<list-item>`>> element; also,
                        possibly to a <<element-def-list,`<def-list>`>> or
                        <<element-def-item,`<def-item>`>> element).
| other| None of the items listed.
| plate| Plate.
| scheme| Scheme.
| sec| Section.
| statement| Statement.
| supplementary-material| Supplementary information.
| table| Table or group of tables (to a <<element-table-wrap,`<table-wrap>`>> or <<element-table-wrap-group,`<table-wrap-group>`>> element).
| table-fn| Table footnote.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===

#### Tagged Samples

#### Cross-reference to figure

[source,xml]
....
...
<sec id="s5_1">
 <label>5.1</label>
 <title>Two approaches to addressing accessibility in 
  standards</title>
 ...
 <p><xref ref-type="fig" rid="f1">Figure 1</xref> provides 
  a graphical summary of how this Guide can be used.</p>
 <fig id="f1" orientation="portrait" position="anchor">
  <label>Figure 1</label>
  <caption>
   <title>Two approaches to address accessibility in 
    standards</title>
  </caption>
  <graphic xlink:href="g3658.jpg"/>
 </fig>
 ...
</sec>
...
....
